test_AnyoneMayRelayASignedAttestation().notice: Submission is permissionless: the signature is the authority, not the caller.

test_BackdatedAttestationRejected().notice: A newer nonce carrying an older reserve reading would rewind the proof clock.

test_DigestIsBoundToChainAndContract().notice: The domain separator binds the digest to this chain and this address, so an attestation signed for another deployment cannot be replayed here.

test_MalleableSignatureRejected().notice: A signature (v, r, s) has a twin (v', r, N - s) that recovers the same signer. Accepting both would let the same proof be counted under two distinct blobs.

test_RevocationIsImmediate().notice: Revocation shrinks what the oracle believes, so it is immediate by design.

test_SignedProofUnlocksSettleAndBoundsIt.notice: The full Arc path in one test: an attestor signs a USDC reserve figure, the oracle verifies the signature on-chain, and only then can a claim be settled, bounded by exactly that figure and not one unit more.

test_TamperedAmountRejected().notice: Re-signing over different numbers than were submitted must not verify.
